summary: The agent made a plan in message 1 and executed it in a venv in message 2. It downloaded the MUSE vectors and computed C1–C3, C5, C6 and C9 correctly, and it honestly reported the FR mismatch, the Shift-EN/FR failures and the p-value non-reproduction. It surfaced several [R] items well: the doPCA bug with its effect, the orthogonal-alignment explanation for Hybrid=Shift and De-Align, the SVC vs LDA mismatch, the missing code, and no French in SemEval. It declared the qualitative bias-reduction claim to survive, and treated the match of the post-Shift value as validation, which are endorsements of the circular evaluation. Word-pair, Spearman and the FR source were not completed.
